info.name: Assignment Management API
info.description:
Importable collection for the Assignment Management .NET 8 API.

Set the `baseUrl` variable to http://localhost:8080 (Docker) or http://localhost:5080 (local). Run a login request under Auth first; it saves the JWT into the `token` collection variable, which every other request reuses.

Switch which account you are acting as by editing the login body (seeded accounts: admin@example.com / Admin@123, teacher@example.com / Teacher@123, student@example.com / Student@123).
